on_screen_text.text: President Trump Wants Every Agency to be Fully Funded and Fully Reopened

spoken_summary: Karoline Leavitt states that President Trump wants the Department of Homeland Security, TSA, FEMA, and the Coast Guard fully funded so their employees can be paid. She urges Americans who are without a paycheck or are experiencing long airport lines to call their Democratic member of Congress and tell them to fund the Department of Homeland Security. She concludes by calling it "ridiculous" that Americans are suffering due to "partisan games" played by Democrats.
audio_music: The video consists entirely of a person speaking. There is no background music or other audio.
editing_pacing: The video is a static, talking-head shot of the speaker, with text overlays appearing. It concludes with a short, black-and-white montage.
emotions_signaled: Sympathy (for affected Americans and federal workers)
central_claim: Democrats are responsible for a government shutdown that is causing Americans to suffer, and they should be pressured to fund the Department of Homeland Security as President Trump wants.
intended_effect: To direct public anger towards Democratic lawmakers and mobilize viewers to pressure them into funding government agencies.
